title: AERIS: Argonne Earth Systems Model for Reliable and Skillful Predictions
problem: Weather forecasting with deterministic methods has spectral biases and poor ensemble calibration; high-resolution scaling is difficult.
motivation: Generative ML enables better Earth system modeling; diffusion models show promise but scaling to high resolution is challenging.
method: AERIS: 1.3-80B parameter pixel-level Swin diffusion transformer with SWiPe parallelism technique (window+sequence+pipeline parallelism without extra communication).
key_novelty: Billion-parameter diffusion transformer for Earth systems + SWiPe composable parallelism for window-based transformers
limitations: Specific to Earth systems; scalability to other generative tasks not addressed.
